title: Let’s Get Physical!
subtitle: Summer 2 · 6-week overview
summary: Building confidence with new physical challenges, practising gross motor skills, reacting to action words and copying actions to music while playing alongside friends.
intentions: To develop confidence in trying new physical challenges with adult support.
To enjoy playing alongside or with other children in physical play.
To react to action words like jump, stop and go.
To practise gross motor skills such as crawling, walking, climbing, balancing, or rolling.
To copy simple actions in response to music or adult modelling.
books: Busy Sports Day by Campbell Books
songs: Shake Your Sillies Out by The Wiggles

events.label: International Picnic Day: Setting up a picnic in the garden!

days.title: Shaving foam and sand
days.what: Set up the messy tray with shaving foam. Add some sand for texture. Allow the children to explore.

days.title: Obstacle course
days.what: Set up an obstacle course in the garden and encourage the children to have a go, supporting them where needed.

days.title: Large scale drawing
days.what: Set large pieces of card on the floor and provide felt tip pens. Allow the children to make marks.

days.title: Hairdressers pretend play
days.what: Provide the hairdressers resources and encourage the children to explore and play.

days.title: Toilet roll play
days.what: Provide some toilet rolls. Allow the children to roll them around the room and explore the tissue.

days.title: Pots and pans play
days.what: Provide some pots and pans and wooden spoons. Encourage the children to bang the pots and pans using the wooden spoons to make different sounds.

days.title: Feet painting
days.what: Set up large pieces of card on the floor and some paint. Take off the children’s socks and encourage them to step into the paint, making marks on the card.

days.title: Princess/dragons and castles small world
days.what: Bring over the princesses, dragons and castles small world from pre-school. Allow the children to explore.

days.title: Homemade playdough
days.what: Mix up some playdough and allow the children to explore. Provide rolling pins, cookie cutters and stampers.

days.title: Running games in the garden
days.what: Encourage the children to run around the garden, shouting “stop” and “go!”

days.title: Mark making using paint sticks
days.what: Provide some card and the paint sticks, allowing the children to make marks.

days.title: Doctors pretend play
days.what: Provide the doctors pretend play resources and encourage the children to explore and play.
